devon: Heads-up: multiple onboarding repos failing after we switched the package exports to ESM-first in 2.1.0. Errors surface differently on Vercel Edge, Cloudflare, and Node bundlers.

devon: Example error in a Vercel preview: `ReferenceError: fetch is not defined` coming from our auth retry layer.

kamal: I pulled the package tarball  package.json currently uses an exports object that only lists an `import` target for `.` and `./runtime`. No `require` target and no subpath exports for `./auth`. That explains why some consumers can't reach our auth shim.

sara: Also seeing TS failures in sample-apps CI: `Could not find a declaration file for module '@redwood/inference-js'`. Looks like the new exports map hides the d.ts files from TypeScript resolver.

devon: Repro locally: `node samples/demo.js` fails only when letting Node pick the package entry; forcing `require('.../dist/index.cjs')` works. Edge sandboxes choose different entrypoints and end up hitting server-only code.

kamal: Quick mitigation plan: add conditional exports for both `import` and `require`, restore explicit subpath exports for `./auth` and `./adapters/*`, include `./package.json` in exports, and add a top-level `types` field pointing at `dist/index.d.ts`. Example patch snippet: "exports": {".":{"import":"./dist/index.mjs","require":"./dist/index.cjs","default":"./dist/index.cjs"},"./auth":{"import":"./dist/auth/index.mjs","require":"./dist/auth/index.cjs"},"./package.json":"./package.json"}.

sara: For TypeScript, also add `typesVersions` fallback for older TS so consumers on TS <4.5 still resolve d.ts.

devon: Runtime tweak: replace `if (typeof fetch !== 'function') throw` with a small adapter `const _fetch = globalThis.fetch ?? (() => { try { return require('node-fetch'); } catch { return undefined; } })();` and only throw if still undefined. Keeps edge and browser polyfills happy.

release-bot: CI started for branch fix/exportmap-2.1.1.

kamal: I'll open a PR and run a light smoke test against Cloudflare Workers and a Vercel preview to validate edge import paths.

sara: I'll update sample-apps to pin to 2.1.1 once published and add a CI job to run a Node + Cloudflare import smoke test on publish.

devon: Agreed. Also add a short note to release notes: "Fix: restore CJS entry and subpath exports; restore typings mapping to avoid import and TS resolution regressions."

release-bot: Lint failed on PR (line-length in adapter). Quick fix pushed.

kamal: PR merged, publishing 2.1.1. Samples verified on Vercel and Node. Monitoring error rate. Thanks folks.
